description: This file defines CRUD API endpoints for managing reusable credentials using FastAPI. It includes classes and functions for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting credentials, with integration to a database and external services.

classes.name: CredentialHelperUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for encrypting credential values.

methods.name: encrypt_credential_values
methods.description: Encrypts the credential values within a CredentialItem, optionally using a new encryption key.

methods.name: create_credential
methods.description: API endpoint to create and store a new credential, with optional model ID handling and credential encryption.

methods.name: get_credentials
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve all stored credentials with masked values.

methods.name: get_credential
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve a credential by name or associated model ID, with masked values.

methods.name: delete_credential
methods.description: API endpoint to delete a credential by name.

methods.name: update_db_credential
methods.description: Utility function to merge and encrypt updates to a credential in the database.

methods.name: update_credential
methods.description: API endpoint to update an existing credential in the database.
